task.summary: Analyze Doctrine ORM issue #12555 on partial lazy-load column selection and keep any proposed direction aligned with Doctrine rules.

events.summary: Issue #12555 depends on the partial-native-lazy feature merged by PR #12210.
events.material_effect: The analysis target is Doctrine ORM 3.7.x behavior, not the current 3.6.x-based branch that lacks partialObjectLoadedFields.
evidence: https://github.com/doctrine/orm/issues/12555
https://github.com/doctrine/orm/pull/12210

events.summary: Partial lazy initialization currently delegates to a generic full-entity persister load.
events.material_effect: The inefficiency is triggered after a partial DQL object is created as a native lazy ghost and an unloaded field is accessed; ProxyFactory calls loadById without selected-field context.
evidence: upstream/3.7.x src/UnitOfWork.php createEntity partial branch calls ProxyFactory::getProxy with assignIdentifiers=false
upstream/3.7.x src/Proxy/ProxyFactory.php native lazy initializer calls EntityPersister::loadById
upstream/3.7.x src/Persisters/Entity/BasicEntityPersister.php getSelectColumnsSQL selects all field names into a shared cached ResultSetMapping

events.summary: A Doctrine-compatible fix should be a narrow selected-column optimization for partial native lazy initialization.
events.material_effect: The direction must preserve explicit partial opt-in, regular proxy loads, refresh, full loads, second-level cache contracts, and inheritance fallback behavior; it should avoid changing EntityPersister signatures unless maintainers accept that BC cost.
evidence: upstream/3.7.x docs/en/reference/partial-objects.rst documents transparent lazy loading only with native lazy objects enabled
upstream/3.7.x docs/en/reference/limitations-and-known-issues.rst says custom persisters are not currently replaceable
upstream/3.7.x src/Cache/Persister/Entity/AbstractEntityPersister.php wraps load and loadById for second-level cache

events.summary: Coverage must prove selected-column SQL and unchanged adjacent behavior.
events.material_effect: Required tests belong near PartialObjectsTest plus focused cache/proxy coverage: omitted already-loaded columns, retained identifier/version columns, unchanged full proxy/find/refresh behavior, no shared RSM cache pollution, embeddable trigger behavior, and inheritance fallback.
evidence: upstream/3.7.x tests/Tests/ORM/Functional/PartialObjectsTest.php covers partial native lazy merge safety but not SQL column selection
upstream/3.7.x tests/Tests/OrmFunctionalTestCase.php provides getQueryLog and assertQueryCount helpers
upstream/3.7.x tests/Tests/ORM/Functional/SecondLevelCacheQueryCacheTest.php asserts cacheable partial queries remain unsupported

events.summary: Second-level cache needs explicit handling for selected-column partial lazy initialization.
events.material_effect: A selected-load path through cached persisters must avoid storing a cache entry built from an entity whose already-loaded fields may contain local pre-initialization changes.
evidence: upstream/3.7.x src/Cache/Persister/Entity/AbstractEntityPersister.php loadById can load into an existing entity and then build a cache entry from that entity
upstream/3.7.x tests/Tests/ORM/Functional/SecondLevelCacheQueryCacheTest.php covers partial query cache rejection but not entity-cache lazy-init storage after local partial changes

events.summary: Selected-column lazy initialization must include owning to-one join columns or preserve their equivalent metadata.
events.material_effect: A scalar-only restricted SELECT can make UnitOfWork treat non-null owning to-one associations as null during createEntity, contradicting normal full-load semantics.
evidence: upstream/3.7.x src/Persisters/Entity/BasicEntityPersister.php getSelectColumnAssociationSQL maps owning to-one join columns as meta results
upstream/3.7.x src/Internal/Hydration/SimpleObjectHydrator.php copies meta-mapped columns into createEntity data
upstream/3.7.x src/UnitOfWork.php createEntity derives owning to-one association identifiers from row join-column values

events.summary: The preferred implementation shape avoids changing the public EntityPersister interface.
events.material_effect: Use a Doctrine-owned internal selected-load capability or equivalent internal path for partial native lazy initialization, falling back to loadById for unsupported persisters, inheritance, eager joins, and regular reference proxies.
evidence: upstream/3.7.x src/Persisters/Entity/EntityPersister.php exposes load and loadById as interface methods
upstream/3.7.x docs/en/reference/limitations-and-known-issues.rst says per-entity custom persister replacement is not currently supported
upstream/3.7.x docs/en/reference/second-level-cache.rst documents cache factory/persister extension surfaces

events.summary: Coverage must include metadata, cache, fallback, and shared-RSM isolation cases before implementation is accepted.
events.material_effect: The test matrix now explicitly includes owning to-one join-column preservation, null association preservation, second-level cache no-poisoning, simple restricted SQL, embeddable initialization, normal proxy/find/refresh unaffected behavior, inheritance and eager-association fallback, composite identifiers, version fields, filters, and read-only hints.
evidence: upstream/3.7.x src/Persisters/Entity/BasicEntityPersister.php caches full selectColumnListSql and mutates the shared ResultSetMapping
upstream/3.7.x src/Internal/Hydration/AbstractHydrator.php distinguishes meta mappings from field mappings
upstream/3.7.x src/Internal/Hydration/ObjectHydrator.php and SimpleObjectHydrator.php pass partial hints into UnitOfWork::createEntity
upstream/3.7.x tests/Tests/ORM/Functional/PartialObjectsTest.php and ValueObjectsTest.php contain existing partial-native-lazy coverage

events.summary: Implemented selected-column partial lazy initialization without changing EntityPersister signatures.
events.material_effect: UnitOfWork now exposes DQL partial loaded fields internally; BasicEntityPersister uses a fresh one-shot persister context/RSM for eligible partial lazy loads, includes owning to-one FK metadata, and falls back for inheritance, joined association loads, locks, custom criteria, and regular proxies; cached entity persisters bypass SLC for this path.
